function Words(n: integer; to19: List<string>; tens: List<string>): string;
begin
  if n < 20 then
    Result := to19[n]
  else if n < 100 then
  begin
    if n mod 10 = 0 then
      Result := tens[n div 10 - 2]
    else
      Result := tens[n div 10 - 2] + ' ' + to19[n mod 10];
  end
  else if n < 1000 then
  begin
    if n mod 100 = 0 then
      Result := to19[n div 100] + ' Hundred'
    else
      Result := to19[n div 100] + ' Hundred ' + Words(n mod 100, to19, tens);
  end
  else if n < 1000000 then
  begin
    if n mod 1000 = 0 then
      Result := Words(n div 1000, to19, tens) + ' Thousand'
    else
      Result := Words(n div 1000, to19, tens) + ' Thousand ' + Words(n mod 1000, to19, tens);
  end
  else if n < 1000000000 then
  begin
    if n mod 1000000 = 0 then
      Result := Words(n div 1000000, to19, tens) + ' Million'
    else
      Result := Words(n div 1000000, to19, tens) + ' Million ' + Words(n mod 1000000, to19, tens);
  end
  else
  begin
    if n mod 1000000000 = 0 then
      Result := Words(n div 1000000000, to19, tens) + ' Billion'
    else
      Result := Words(n div 1000000000, to19, tens) + ' Billion ' + Words(n mod 1000000000, to19, tens);
  end;
end;

function NumberToWords(num: integer): string;
begin
  var to19 := 'Zero One Two Three Four Five Six Seven Eight Nine Ten Eleven Twelve Thirteen Fourteen Fifteen Sixteen Seventeen Eighteen Nineteen'.Split(' ').ToList;
  var tens := 'Twenty Thirty Forty Fifty Sixty Seventy Eighty Ninety'.Split(' ').ToList;
  Result := Words(num, to19, tens);
end;
